# Giuseppe Ragusa

[[Github](https://github.com/gragusa) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.it/citations?user=b6fOfJcAAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao)]{.lede}

::: {.teaching-now}
#### Teaching now

::: {#teaching-now}
:::
:::

I am a Professor of Econometrics at the [Department of Economics and Law](https://web.uniroma1.it/dip_ecodir/en) at [Sapienza the University of Rome](https://www.uniroma1.it/).

I am also an affiliated lecturer at the [London Business School](https://www.london.edu).

Before joining  [Sapienza the University of Rome](https://www.uniroma1.it/), I held tenure-track positions at [Rutgers University](https://economics.rutgers.edu/), the [University of California, Irvine](https://www.economics.uci.edu), Luiss University, and the University of Pisa.

From 2015 to 2017, I was a Senior Economist at the Monetary Strategy Division of the  European Central Bank.

I received my Ph.D. in Economics from the [University of California, San Diego](https://economics.ucsd.edu). My undergraduate education is from Bocconi University.

My most recent research interests include: time series, economic forecasting, approximate bayesian inference, and machine learning applications to economics and finance.

I teach undergraduate and graduate Econometrics, Time Series, and Machine Learning courses. These courses use Julia, R, and Python as software.

On this site, I keep [my cv](gragusa_cv.pdf), a list of [my publications](papers), my [code and packages](code), some interesting [data](factors), to my [teaching pages](teaching), and a very infrequently updated [blog](blog).
